create_super_resolution_transform: create a SuperResolutionTransform to downsample then upsample image tensors for training data augmentation
use_forward_method: use the forward method to pass a dict with image data and get low-res augmented output
configure_interpolation_mode: configure the transform with bicubic or bilinear interpolation mode for resizing image tensors
apply_value_clamping: apply min and max value clamping to downsampled and upsampled tensor data
add_augmentation_function: add a custom augmentation function to apply extra transforms on the downsampled tensor
